stem: During a 3-week promotion, Voltmarkt's 65-inch TV averaged 50 units a week against a baseline of 20. In the same TV category, the 55-inch model fell from a baseline of 25 to an average of 16 units a week, and the 75-inch model from 10 to 8. A computer monitor, in the monitors category, fell from 6 to 4 units a week. None of these other products was on promotion. Voltmarkt's cannibalisation rate is 100 × the units lost by non-promoted products in the promoted product's own category / the promoted product's extra units, both counted over all the promotion weeks. What is the cannibalisation rate? Give a percentage with 1 decimal.
